title: Metric Mosaic: compact multi-metric card system — dark mode motion & edge-case handoff
creator: Ava Rodriguez
description: Design and handoff for a compact ‘Metric Mosaic’ card system that surfaces up to 6 metrics per tile for Console dashboards and rollout summaries. Goal: a dense, scannable compact card that adapts across density settings and supports dark mode, motion for status changes, and robust empty/fallback states. This ticket covers final visual polish, accessibility pass, interactive prototype, and engineering handoff artifacts. Focus areas: hierarchy for mixed metric types (latency/cost/error rate), microcopy for metric deltas, animation guidelines for metric transitions, and visual treatment for canary vs. production routes.

decision_log: Metric ordering: SLA breach > error rate > latency > cost > usage > custom metric. Rationale: reliability-first for rollouts.
Animations: use subtle vertical micro-transitions for value changes; large changes get a 240ms emphasize pulse. Respect reduce-motion user preference.
Dark-mode: raise background depth by +6% and increase delta chip border for legibility based on accessibility review.
Refresh cadence: default 5s for glance dashboards, 10s for compact/micro to reduce N+1 updates. Allow config override in Dedicated customers.
Empty state: show last-known value with 'stale' timestamp and a compact CTA to open ingestion diagnostics in the rollout inspector.
Canary stripe: orange 3px left border + 'canary' badge. Production route gets primary accent.
visual_specs: Figma file: Metric Mosaic — pages: Specs | Tokens | Prototype. Tokens exported: color.json, spacing.json, motion.json. See attachment 1.
qa_checklist: Verify compact / micro / comfortable density breakpoints at 320px / 480px / 720px widths
Dark mode contrast checks for all delta states (positive/negative/neutral)
Motion turned off: transitions should be instant and no content shifts
Screen reader: aria-live announces metric name + direction + delta (e.g., 'Latency increased 20%')
Stale data flow: simulate metric outage and confirm 'stale: Xm' microcopy + diagnostic link
Canary visualization: validate stripe color + hover tooltip shows route details
Export tokens: validate token names match runtime variables used by ENG-22134
accessibility_notes: Show explicit examples for color-blindness: do not rely on hue alone for delta direction (use icon + text). Provide high-contrast delta variants for both light and dark themes. Motion guidelines must include reduced-motion breakpoint and prefers-reduced-motion polyfill for older browsers.
